spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Many, various.
E.
न neg. एक one.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Near, being near.
E.
निकट, and ठञ् aff.

n. (-ट्यं)
Proximity, vicinage.
E.
निकट, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Various, multiform, manifold.
E.
नैक, and भेद kind.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Multiform.
E.
नैक, and रूप form.

m. (-यः)
A Rākṣasa, a fiend, a goblin.
E.
निकषा the mother of the race, and ढक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Morose, harsh spoken.
2 Wicked, bad.
E.
निकृति, and ठक् aff.
